performers.note: An unidentified pianist accompanies her. Biographical references to her regular accompanists do not establish the player on this side.

date.note: Commons gives 5 June 1925. The upstream discography dates matrix F 87 only circa 1925; its exact 5 June dates belong to FX 51/56, not this side.

place.note: No recording venue is established by the sources.

catalogue.note: The upstream file tags, table and companion label name D 9758; Commons says D 9768 and also mentions Polyphon 31314. The transferred Columbia issue follows the upstream record.

matrixTakeSides.note: Both sources identify F 87. No take is supplied.

credits.note: The upstream upload is associated with Rolf Sinnema; the page does not explicitly identify the transfer engineer.

date.note: September 2023 is the upload date, not a documented transfer date.

processing.note: No restoration or speed-correction procedure is documented. The comparison rolls features by one semitone but does not change playback audio.

composition.note: PD-old-70 and PD-US-expired do not themselves clear a sound recording.

recording.note: Rule 3: the upstream catalogue identifies this historical Columbia D 9758/F 87 issue as circa 1925, establishing publication before 1963. Its European 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension. Exact first-publication year at the US cutoff is not independently established, and US public-domain status is not asserted. Opened IA metadata has no licenseurl and no non-commercial licence. The Commons composition-only tags are not the acceptance basis.

rights.creditLine: Camille Saint-Saëns, Le Cygne; Judith Bokor, cello, with unidentified pianist; Columbia D 9758, matrix F 87, circa 1925. Rolf Sinnema collection on Internet Archive, via Wikimedia Commons. European recording-rights expiry only; US status unestablished.
